suggested_policies.rationale: HLD_GCP_094 requires google_compute_network resources to set delete_default_routes_on_create = true, but no policy checks that a replacement google_compute_route exists. Building example/examplea hit this directly: the network deleted its default route and initially had no replacement, which would have left every instance on the network with no egress path while terraform plan/apply succeeded silently. This is a concrete, repeatable, attribute-level pattern (requires_companion), not context-dependent, and coverage_by_type for google_compute_route is empty in this repo's holden scan, so it is not already covered.
suggested_policies.yaml:
id: HLD_PROPOSED_001
name: GCP VPC networks that delete default routes must have an explicit replacement route
principle: reliability
severity: HIGH
rationale: |
  HLD_GCP_094 requires delete_default_routes_on_create = true on every
  google_compute_network, which removes the automatically-created 0.0.0.0/0
  route through default-internet-gateway. If no google_compute_route resource
  is created to replace it, the network has zero egress path: instances cannot
  reach the internet, GCP API endpoints, or any destination outside the VPC.
  Terraform plan and apply both succeed with no error or warning, so the
  network looks correctly hardened while every workload on it is silently
  isolated until someone notices outbound connectivity is broken.
remediation: |
  Add a google_compute_route for each egress path the network actually needs,
  for example default internet egress via Cloud NAT or the internet gateway:

    resource "google_compute_route" "default_internet" {
      name             = "default-internet"
      network          = google_compute_network.main.self_link
      dest_range       = "0.0.0.0/0"
      next_hop_gateway = "default-internet-gateway"
      priority         = 1000
    }
resources:
  google_compute_network:
    filter:
      path: delete_default_routes_on_create
      equals: true
    requires_companion:
      type: google_compute_route
      via: network
